en.summary: Four quality levels, improved two-pass sampling, and sharing exports.
changes: Choose Light, Medium, High or Max with the quality slider. Light enables two-pass acceleration by default; higher levels use 12, 16 or 20 steps.
Two-pass sampling now uses 8 initial steps and an independent 3-step refinement schedule.
Optionally install all quality caches during setup, or download only missing caches before your first run. Download time is kept separate from generation time.
Export a sharing image or video with generation statistics.

zh.summary: 四档质量滑块，更新二次采样与分享导出。
changes: 质量滑块提供四档。最低档默认开启二次采样加速，其余三档使用 12、16、20 步单采。
默认使用一采 8 步与独立时间表二采 3 步。
安装时可选下载全部档位缓存，也可首次运行前补装所需缓存；下载不计入生成耗时。
导出带生成统计的分享图片或视频。
